name: Tennin Kyoushi
source:
Koinuma Hitomi is new female teacher just transferred to the school. This is a school for delinquents, and she will have to establish her authority not only by words, but by weapons such as whip as well.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
鲤沼瞳是一名刚刚调任该校的女教师。这里是一所问题学生云集的学校，她必须树立自己的威信，而且不能只靠言语，还要动用鞭子之类的武器。

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/11/vn-of-month-november-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
